page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-16-lssd is a virtual machine instance within the c4n server family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and is equipped with 60.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.75 GB of RAM per core. This configuration provides a balanced allocation of compute and memory resources for standard workloads.

The instance includes 805 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, distributed across 2 local SSDs. This local storage configuration supports high-speed read and write operations directly attached to the instance. There are no integrated GPUs, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and integrated local NVMe SSD storage, this instance is suited for workloads requiring fast local disk access alongside moderate compute capabilities. Typical applications include database hosting, local caching layers, and general-purpose application servers.
